(Japanese: '''カラクサタウンのどろぼうポケモン''' ''{{tt|Karakusa|Accumula}} Town's Thief Pokémon'') is the second chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters BW: Good Partners]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Takurō]] and [[Mashiro]] meet with [[Professor Juniper]] at [[Accumula Town]].
* Takurō bag is stolen by a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Purrloin}}.
* Takurō is revealed to own a {{p|Pidove}}.
* Takurō befriends Purrloin after saving it and himself from falling off a cliff.
* Takurō {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} Purrloin.
